interpretation: Descriptive synthetic-set ablation, not a population guarantee. The bootstrap only reflects these 24 case clusters. Labels are authored expectations, not an independent audit. Guidance and cases were designed by the same author. Model reasoning evidence is retained but not semantically scored; exact match grades label sets only.

protocol.design: Same model, task, observation and output schema in both arms. The skill arm additionally receives the frozen SKILL.md body and failure-modes reference. One independent request per observation; no conversation history. Each pair runs back to back with seeded random arm order. No automatic retries or post-result tuning.
protocol.limits: 24 author-constructed Chinese synthetic traces, not a public benchmark or blind external holdout. Two repetitions per case are correlated; bootstrap is clustered by the 24 cases. Tests explicit guidance loading only, not tool-use or trigger accuracy. Model route supplied by DMXAPI; underlying model identity is not independently verified. No estimate of monetary cost.
protocol.primary_metric: Exact match of all defect labels per scheduled case-run; format, transport and missing results count as incorrect.
